description: mgr-applications configuration template. Default values are calibrated against the bugfest environment reference baseline as required by ADR-0013 (Module configuration management). Values for secrets and environment-specific endpoints have no default and must be provided by the deployment.

deployment.description: Deployment configuration for the backend module. Adjust replicas based on expected load and HA requirements. Set to false if only single instance is supported or required.

kong.description: Custom API Gateway (Kong) proxy timeouts for the module routes. Use this only if different from default Kong configuration

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: Postgres database name

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: Postgres hostname

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Postgres username password

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: Postgres port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: Postgres username

EnvVars.name: APIGW_API_KEY
EnvVars.description: APISIX Admin API key (sent as X-API-KEY). Required when APIGW_TYPE=apisix; ignored for Kong.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for establishing a connection from the gateway to upstream service. If not provided then gateway defaults are applied.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Defines if API Gateway integration is enabled or disabled. If set to false - it will exclude all gateway-related beans from spring context.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds between two successive read operations for transmitting a request from the gateway to the upstream service. If not provided then gateway defaults are applied.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_REGISTER_MODULE
EnvVars.description: Defines if module must be registered in the API Gateway (it will create for itself service and list of routes from module descriptor).

EnvVars.name: APIGW_RETRIES
EnvVars.description: Number of retries to execute upon failure to proxy. If not provided then gateway defaults are applied.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Allows to enable/disable TLS connection to the API Gateway.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for TLS connection to the API Gateway.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for TLS connection to the API Gateway.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore type for TLS connection to the API Gateway.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Active API Gateway implementation: kong or apisix. Selects which integration library performs self-registration; APIGW_URL and APIGW_TLS_* apply to the selected gateway.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_URL
EnvVars.description: API Gateway Admin URL used to perform HTTP requests for self-registration, required unless APIGW_ENABLED=false.

EnvVars.name: APIGW_WRITE_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds between two successive write operations for transmitting a request from the gateway to the upstream service. If not provided then gateway defaults are applied.

EnvVars.name: KONG_ADMIN_URL
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_URL instead. Used only when APIGW_URL is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_CONNECT_TIMEOUT instead. Used only when APIGW_CONNECT_TIMEOUT is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_ENABLED instead. Used only when APIGW_ENABLED is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_READ_TIMEOUT instead. Used only when APIGW_READ_TIMEOUT is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_RETRIES
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_RETRIES instead. Used only when APIGW_RETRIES is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_TLS_ENABLED instead. Used only when APIGW_TLS_ENABLED is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD instead. Used only when APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH instead. Used only when APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE instead. Used only when APIGW_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: KONG_WRITE_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_WRITE_TIMEOUT instead. Used only when APIGW_WRITE_TIMEOUT is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Module URL (module cannot define url for gateway registration by itself, because it can be under Load Balancer, so this value must be provided manually).

EnvVars.name: REGISTER_MODULE_IN_KONG
EnvVars.description: Deprecated: use APIGW_REGISTER_MODULE instead. Used only when APIGW_REGISTER_MODULE is not set; planned removal in the Vetch release.

EnvVars.name: kong.url
EnvVars.description: Lowest-precedence system-property fallback for APIGW_URL, used by the integration test infrastructure.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_DISCOVERY_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Amount of partitions for discovery topic.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_DISCOVERY_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor for discovery topic. If not set the Kafka broker default is applied.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker hostname

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Kafka security protocol

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Kafka SSL keystore location

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Kafka SSL keystore password

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Kafka SSL truststore location

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Kafka SSL truststore password

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client id. Used for register/create necessary records in keycloak from the internal module descriptor.

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client secret. Conditionally required (only if admin username/password are not set) when Keycloak import is enabled.

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_GRANT_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin grant type. Should be set to password if username/password are used instead of client secret.

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin password. Conditionally required (only if admin client secret is not set) when Keycloak import is enabled.

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin username. Conditionally required (only if admin client secret is not set) when Keycloak import is enabled.

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTH_TOKEN_VALIDATE_URI
EnvVars.description: Defines if validation for JWT must be run to compare configuration URL and token issuer for keycloak.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Client id to be imported to Keycloak.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for keycloak clients.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for keycloak clients.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for keycloak clients.

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for keycloak clients.

EnvVars.name: KC_FORCED_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Forced jwks refresh interval for realm JWT parser (used in signing key rotation, in minutes).

EnvVars.name: KC_IMPORT_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: If true - at startup, register/create necessary records in keycloak from the internal module descriptor.

EnvVars.name: KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Defines if Keycloak integration is enabled or disabled. If set to false - it will exclude all keycloak-related beans from spring context.

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_BASE_URL
EnvVars.description: Custom base URL for JWKS endpoint. If specified, will be used instead of issuer URL from token's iss claim (e.g., http://keycloak:8080).

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Jwks refresh interval for realm JWT parser (in minutes).

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Keycloak URL used to perform HTTP requests.

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. In Ramsons and Sunflower defaults to ENV with fall-back folio.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: The HTTP endpoint to use for retrieving AWS credentials. This is ignored if useIAM is true.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: The path component of the credentials endpoint URI. This value is appended to the credentials endpoint to form the URI from which credentials can be obtained.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: The AWS region to pass to the AWS SSM Client Builder. If not set, the AWS Default Region Provider Chain is used to determine which region to use.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: If true, will rely on the current IAM role for authorization instead of explicitly providing AWS credentials (access_key/secret_key).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: The address (URL) of the FSSP service.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to FSSP.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_SECRET_PATH
EnvVars.description: The path in FSSP where secrets are stored/retrieved.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: The type of the truststore file (e.g., JKS, PKCS12).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: The password for the truststore file.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the truststore file for SSL connections.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure storage type. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: The address of your vault.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether or not to use SSL.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: The path to a JKS keystore file containing a client cert and private key.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: The password used to access the JKS keystore (optional).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: The path to an X.509 certificate in unencrypted PEM format, using UTF-8 encoding.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Token for accessing vault, may be a root token.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: The path to a JKS truststore file containing Vault server certs that can be trusted.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Manage server's mode. If true then SSL will be enabled.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for key in keystore. Mandatory if SERVER_SSL_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_KEY_STORE
EnvVars.description: Path to the keystore. Mandatory if SERVER_SSL_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_KEY_STORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for keystore. Mandatory if SERVER_SSL_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_KEY_STORE_PROVIDER
EnvVars.description: Provider of the keystore.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_SSL_KEY_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the keystore. By default BCFKS value is used.

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Allows to enable/disable TLS connection to mgr-tenant-entitlements module.

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for TLS connection to mgr-tenant-entitlements module.

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for TLS connection to mgr-tenant-entitlements module.

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for TLS connection to mgr-tenant-entitlements module.

EnvVars.name: TE_URL
EnvVars.description: Tenant Entitlement URL used to perform HTTP requests by TenantEntitlementClient. Falls back to http://mgr-tenant-entitlements:8081 when not set.

EnvVars.name: te.url
EnvVars.description: Lowest-precedence property fallback for TE_URL (same setting via Spring relaxed binding).

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: The logical name of the deployment (kafka topic prefix), must be unique across all environments using the same shared Kafka/Elasticsearch clusters, a-z (any case), 0-9, -, _ symbols only allowed.

EnvVars.name: FAR_MODE
EnvVars.description: Allows to enable Folio Application Registry mode, if FAR mode is enabled, API Gateway integration must be disabled using environment variable APIGW_ENABLED.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Java options for the container JVM (heap and metaspace sizing, see the java defaults above). The container runtime derives defaults when unset.

EnvVars.name: MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_HEADER_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request header.

EnvVars.name: ROUTER_PATH_PREFIX
EnvVars.description: Defines routes prefix to be added to the generated endpoints by OpenAPI generator (/foo/entites -> {{prefix}}/foo/entities). Required if load balancing group has format like {{host}}/{{moduleId}}; empty (no prefix) by default.

EnvVars.name: SECURITY_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Allows to enable/disable security. If true and KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED is also true - the Keycloak will be used as a security provider.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: Server HTTP port. Should be specified manually in case of SSL enabled.

EnvVars.name: VALIDATION_MODE
EnvVars.description: Validation mode applied during Application Descriptors checking (see POST /applications/validate endpoint). Possible values: none, basic, onCreate.

EnvVars.name: tenant.url
EnvVars.description: Tenant URL used to perform HTTP requests by TenantManagerClient.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_BOOTSTRAP_CACHE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables application-scoped egress bootstrap caching. Discovery locations are always read from the database.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_BOOTSTRAP_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of applications held in the egress bootstrap cache.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_BOOTSTRAP_CACHE_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time after last access before an application bootstrap cache entry expires.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Environment

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Java options

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTHORIZATION_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum amount of entries for keycloak authorization cache.

EnvVars.name: KC_URI_VALIDATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Defines if JsonWebTokenParser compares URI from token with KC_URL value.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_HTTP_LIMITS_MAX_BODY_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body the sidecar accepts; must accommodate large application descriptors.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_HTTP_LIMITS_MAX_INITIAL_LINE_LENGTH
EnvVars.description: Maximum length of the HTTP request initial line.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_OTEL_SDK_DISABLED
EnvVars.description: Disables the OpenTelemetry SDK in the sidecar.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_REST_CLIENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Connect timeout in milliseconds for the sidecar REST client.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_REST_CLIENT_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Read timeout in milliseconds for the sidecar REST client.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_REST_CLIENT_SEND_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Send timeout in milliseconds for the sidecar REST client.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_THREADS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of threads in the sidecar thread pool.

EnvVars.name: QUARKUS_VERTX_EVENT_LOOPS_POOL_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Number of Vert.x event loop threads in the sidecar.

EnvVars.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Configures the amount of time in milliseconds after which if the request does not return any data within the timeout period fails the request.

EnvVars.name: SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Set behavior for EGRESS request. If there is no information about discovery, request will be forwarded to the SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS_DESTINATION. If SIDECAR_FORWARD_UNKNOWN_REQUESTS is enabled, ROUTING_DYNAMIC_ENABLED should be disabled.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_MAX_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Token cache max capacity.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_REFRESH_PRIOR_EXPIRATION
EnvVars.description: Specifies the amount of seconds for a cache entry invalidation prior to the token expiration.
